topic.description: Freeform topic discriminator for the interacted event. Well-known value: "clicked". Custom values: any alphanumeric + underscore/hyphen string ≤64 chars.

defaultChannels.description: Default channel types for new campaigns

realtimeFanout.description: Realtime fanout policy for in_app FeedItem deliveries. Empty array = feed_only (default). Allowed values: 'websocket', 'push'. Consumers of after_feed_item_sent (WebSocket fanout svc, push wake-up svc) self-filter on this array.

config.description: Additional service-level configuration. Supports: deliveryMechanisms: { websocketEnabled: boolean, pushEnabled: boolean } — controls default delivery mechanisms for announcements. Defaults: { websocketEnabled: true, pushEnabled: false }. Feed is always enabled.

channelId.description: Channel instance ID (links to Channel entity)

stopCondition.description: Stop condition for sequence step. Allowed values depend on channelType: feed channels (in_app) accept `delivered` | `read` | `engaged`; push channels accept `delivered` | `clicked`. Validated per-channel at template save (ENG-35239).

waitMinutes.description: Wait time in minutes before advancing to next step

templateId.description: Human-readable slug (auto-generated from name if omitted)

label.description: Display label shown on notification (e.g. Promo, Alert)

alternativeText.description: Plain-text fallback when push is suppressed or rich content cannot render. Sendbird-parity field.
Plain-text fallback when push is suppressed or rich content cannot render. Sendbird-parity field.

channelId.description: Channel slug (auto-generated from name if omitted)

topic.description: Freeform topic discriminator for the interacted event. Custom values: any alphanumeric + underscore/hyphen string ≤64 chars.

variables.description: Campaign-level default variables — applied to every recipient as a fallback layer below per-user CSV values and above template variableSchema defaults. Example: `{ "promoCode": "SUMMER25", "supportEmail": "help@acme.io" }`.

userIds.description: Array of user IDs to add as recipients

userVariables.description: Per-user variables, keyed by userId. Persisted on each `CampaignRecipient.variables` row at insert time. Renderer substitutes these into template content per recipient. Example: `{ "user_42": { "name": "Ajay" }, "user_43": { "name": "Sam" } }`.

s3Key.description: S3 object key of the uploaded CSV file

scheduledAt.description: Scheduled send time as Unix timestamp (seconds)

templateId.description: Template CUID or templateId slug. Template must be in approved status.

receivers.description: Array of target user IDs. 1–10 = realtime (synchronous, returns notificationId immediately). 11–10,000 = batch (asynchronous, returns batchId; processing happens via queue).

variables.description: Per-user variables. Keyed by userId; values are { variableName: value } objects. Variables are applied to the template content at delivery time.

tag.description: Optional analytics tag attached to the send (passes through to delivery records).

notificationId.description: Notification (batch) ID this engagement relates to

userId.description: User ID who triggered the event

topic.description: Topic discriminator for interacted events (≤64 chars)
